themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can perform complex research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including planning, execution, and information retrieval.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focusing on AI tools that assist developers with writing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles highlighting specific AI-powered platforms and software designed to aid researchers in various stages of their work, from literature review to data analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text, such as research papers, articles, or meeting transcripts, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI is being used to inform product decisions, prioritize features, and manage the product lifecycle.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Content related to AI-generated personas or simulated user data for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare, benchmark, or review different AI tools and platforms for research and analysis.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Research and discussions specifically about the use, capabilities, limitations, and user perceptions of AI chatbots.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Articles discussing the application of AI in automating software testing processes, including test case generation and execution.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Studies and discussions on how AI is affecting jobs, skills, and employment trends across various industries.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
